title: Stasis Reel Ruins
description: A woman in a red jumpsuit with 'STASIS' written on the back stands on a decaying theater stage, holding a flashlight that illuminates old film reels and scattered movie posters. Behind her is a dilapidated cinema facade with a glowing pink neon sign reading 'STASIS REEL' and 'FEAR', surrounded by ruined buildings under a dramatic magenta and orange sky.
prompt: A lone woman in a red futuristic jumpsuit stands on the decaying stage of an abandoned cinema, holding a flashlight that cuts through the darkness. The crumbling theater facade features a glowing pink neon sign that reads STASIS REEL and FEAR. Old film reels, scattered movie posters and broken frames litter the ground around her, with overgrown grass and destroyed skyscrapers in the background under a dramatic magenta and orange apocalyptic sky.
